correctness.rationale: The force reduction and converse are exact for positive equilibria. For at most two habitats, either unique reciprocal denominators yield at most one isolated force pair, or a smooth positive continuum excludes isolation. The three-habitat rational example reduces to (U-1)(U-2)=0; exact symbolic checks validate both feasible fixed points. The complete six-dimensional Jacobian polynomials satisfy strict Routh certificates for respectively one sink and a saddle. Nonzero determinants imply robustness.

More general multi-strain results located in abstract form lacked a verified implication, a residual priority risk rather than proof of uniqueness.

value.rationale: Separable colonization is a motivated ecological approximation. The exact minimum habitat-type complexity for isolated coexistence multiplicity is a sharp structural classification; an explicit robust sink/saddle realization distinguishes equilibrium multiplicity from bistability and clarifies what two-habitat persistence models can and cannot represent.
